summary_by_status.title: Result count per reconciliation status
summary_by_status.sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS results
FROM recon_result
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY results DESC, status;

amount_mismatch_patterns.title: Amount differences with a pattern hint
amount_mismatch_patterns.sql:
SELECT s.reference, s.amount AS source_amount, t.amount AS erp_amount,
       ROUND(t.amount - s.amount, 2) AS difference,
       CASE
         WHEN ROUND(t.amount / s.amount, 6) IN (100.0, 0.01)          THEN 'decimal shift'
         WHEN ABS(ROUND((t.amount - s.amount) * 100)) % 900 = 0       THEN 'divisible by 9 - check transposition'
         WHEN ABS(t.amount - s.amount) <= 0.05                        THEN 'rounding'
         ELSE 'unexplained'
       END AS pattern_hint
FROM recon_result r
JOIN legacy_extract s ON s.src_id = r.src_id
JOIN erp_gl_entry t   ON t.je_id = r.je_id
WHERE r.status = 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH'
ORDER BY s.reference;

duplicates_by_load_run.title: Duplicate imports and the load runs they came from
duplicates_by_load_run.sql:
SELECT s.reference, s.amount, k.je_id AS kept_entry, k.load_run AS kept_run, d.je_id AS duplicate_entry, d.load_run AS duplicate_run, d.migration_batch
FROM recon_result r
JOIN legacy_extract s ON s.src_id = r.src_id
JOIN erp_gl_entry d   ON d.je_id = r.je_id
JOIN recon_result rk  ON rk.src_id = r.src_id AND rk.status <> 'DUPLICATE_IN_TARGET'
JOIN erp_gl_entry k   ON k.je_id = rk.je_id
WHERE r.status = 'DUPLICATE_IN_TARGET'
ORDER BY s.reference;

missing_with_staging_reason.title: Source rows missing in the ERP, with the staging-log reason
missing_with_staging_reason.sql:
SELECT s.src_id, s.reference, s.amount, g.load_status, g.reject_reason
FROM recon_result r
JOIN legacy_extract s ON s.src_id = r.src_id
LEFT JOIN staging_log g ON g.src_id = s.src_id
WHERE r.status = 'MISSING_IN_TARGET'
ORDER BY s.src_id;

date_swaps.title: Date differences explained by a day/month swap
date_swaps.sql:
SELECT s.reference, s.posting_date AS source_date, t.posting_date AS erp_date,
       CASE WHEN SUBSTR(s.posting_date, 6, 2) = SUBSTR(t.posting_date, 9, 2)
             AND SUBSTR(s.posting_date, 9, 2) = SUBSTR(t.posting_date, 6, 2)
            THEN 'day/month swapped' ELSE 'other shift' END AS diagnosis
FROM recon_result r
JOIN legacy_extract s ON s.src_id = r.src_id
JOIN erp_gl_entry t   ON t.je_id = r.je_id
WHERE r.status = 'DATE_MISMATCH'
ORDER BY s.reference;

control_totals.title: Control totals — source vs. posted ERP
control_totals.sql:
SELECT (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM legacy_extract)                      AS source_total,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM erp_gl_entry WHERE status = 'POSTED') AS erp_total,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM erp_gl_entry WHERE status = 'POSTED')
     - (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM legacy_extract)                      AS net_difference;

r1_high_velocity.title: R1 — busiest rolling 7-day window vs. max(10, 3 × expected weekly count)
r1_high_velocity.sql:
WITH windows AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.tx_date AS window_start, COUNT(*) AS tx_in_window
  FROM txn a
  JOIN txn b ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id
            AND b.tx_date BETWEEN a.tx_date AND date(a.tx_date, '+6 days')
  GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.tx_id
)
SELECT w.customer_id, MAX(w.tx_in_window) AS max_7d_count,
       ROUND(MAX(10.0, 3.0 * c.expected_monthly_tx_count / 4.33), 2) AS threshold
FROM windows w JOIN customer c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY w.customer_id
HAVING MAX(w.tx_in_window) >= MAX(10.0, 3.0 * c.expected_monthly_tx_count / 4.33)
ORDER BY w.customer_id;

r2_large_vs_profile.title: R2 — single transaction ≥ max($10,000, 3 × declared monthly turnover)
r2_large_vs_profile.sql:
SELECT t.customer_id, t.tx_id, t.tx_date, t.amount, t.reference,
       MAX(10000.0, 3.0 * c.declared_monthly_turnover) AS threshold
FROM txn t JOIN customer c USING (customer_id)
WHERE t.amount >= MAX(10000.0, 3.0 * c.declared_monthly_turnover)
ORDER BY t.customer_id, t.tx_date;

r3_cash_below_threshold.title: R3 — ≥ 3 cash deposits of $9,000–$9,999.99 within 7 days
r3_cash_below_threshold.sql:
WITH band AS (
  SELECT * FROM txn
  WHERE channel = 'cash' AND direction = 'credit' AND amount BETWEEN 9000 AND 9999.99
)
SELECT a.customer_id, a.tx_date AS window_start, COUNT(*) AS deposits, ROUND(SUM(b.amount), 2) AS total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.branch) AS branches
FROM band a
JOIN band b ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id
           AND julianday(b.tx_date) - julianday(a.tx_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 6
GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.tx_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY a.customer_id, window_start;

r4_monthly_inflow.title: R4 — calendar-month credits ≥ 3 × declared monthly turnover
r4_monthly_inflow.sql:
SELECT t.customer_id, substr(t.tx_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS credits,
       c.declared_monthly_turnover, ROUND(SUM(t.amount) / c.declared_monthly_turnover, 1) AS multiple
FROM txn t JOIN customer c USING (customer_id)
WHERE t.direction = 'credit'
GROUP BY t.customer_id, month
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 3 * c.declared_monthly_turnover
ORDER BY t.customer_id, month;

r5_duplicates.title: R5 — identical postings (reference, amount, direction, counterparty) within 1 day
r5_duplicates.sql:
SELECT account_id, customer_id, reference, amount, COUNT(*) AS copies,
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(migration_batch, source_system) || '/run ' || COALESCE(load_run, '-'), ', ') AS lineage
FROM txn
GROUP BY account_id, customer_id, reference, amount, direction, counterparty
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND julianday(MAX(tx_date)) - julianday(MIN(tx_date)) <= 1
ORDER BY customer_id, reference;

erp_cross_check.title: Ledger vs. source ERP document amounts (where they differ)
erp_cross_check.sql:
SELECT t.tx_id, t.customer_id, t.reference, t.amount AS ledger_amount, d.erp_amount, d.erp_doc_id,
       ROUND(t.amount / d.erp_amount, 4) AS ratio, t.migration_batch
FROM txn t
JOIN erp_document d ON d.reference = t.reference AND d.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE ABS(t.amount - d.erp_amount) > 0.005;

monthly_volume_by_channel.title: Monthly CAD volume by channel
monthly_volume_by_channel.sql:
SELECT month, channel, ROUND(SUM(amount_cad), 2) AS amount_cad, COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM fact_payment
WHERE amount_cad IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month, channel
ORDER BY month, channel;

volume_by_segment.title: Volume by customer segment
volume_by_segment.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(d.segment, 'Unknown') AS segment, ROUND(SUM(f.amount_cad), 2) AS amount_cad, COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM fact_payment f
LEFT JOIN dim_customer d ON d.customer_key = f.customer_key
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY amount_cad DESC;

top_customers.title: Top five customers by CAD volume
top_customers.sql:
SELECT d.name, d.segment, ROUND(SUM(f.amount_cad), 2) AS amount_cad, COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM fact_payment f
JOIN dim_customer d ON d.customer_key = f.customer_key
GROUP BY d.customer_key
ORDER BY amount_cad DESC
LIMIT 5;

merged_lineage.title: Facts built from more than one raw delivery (deduplicated)
merged_lineage.sql:
SELECT payment_key, natural_key, lineage_raw_ids
FROM fact_payment
WHERE lineage_raw_ids LIKE '%,%'
ORDER BY payment_key;
